stem: One reason for the wide variety of organic compounds is isomerism, either structural isomerism or stereoisomerism.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Explain the meaning of the term structural isomerism.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Explain the meaning of the term stereoisomerism.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Give two reasons why pent-1-ene does not show stereoisomerism.

parts.text:
A different structural isomer of pent-1-ene shows geometrical isomerism.
